candidate_universe.dependence: Two rules reuse each block;36candidate tasks are18record partitions, not36independent source samples.
candidate_universe.empty_groups: Exclude empty groups from scoring; retain case only if at least k+1 nonempty groups. Report every exclusion and all candidate outcomes.
candidate_universe.rule: Highest exact threshold-proportion first, ties by ascending fixed group ID
candidate_universe.selection: Use all eligible36 partition-rule cases. No type quotas, alternative cutpoints, source retries or search-until-benefit. Zero or unfavourable yield retained.

coding.meaning: Different research-defined thresholds and estimands, deliberately not interchangeable definitions or official operational policy versions.

evaluation_scope: Hypothetical current-allocation review dossiers derived from observed physicochemical/sensory records. Not observed organisational migrations, human reviewer outcomes, or utility evidence.

grouping.ordered_ids: G01..G06 in alcohol-band then pH-band order
grouping.rationale: Fixed research cut points chosen before raw acquisition; not chemical safety standards or empirically optimised partitions.

inspection_boundary.before_freeze: Official UCI metadata, schema, file names and licence only; no raw values acquired or inspected by this R2 task. Public familiarity or model-training exclusion is not claimed.

local_filename_exclusion.not_proof_of_absence: Filename inventory is not a complete semantic content search or model-training exclusion.

output_plan: source acquisition receipt with raw hashes
public eligible dossiers without reference answers
record partition map and duplicate-row audit

partition.same_record_overlap: Each source record belongs to exactly one block. Duplicate row contents and batch/provenance dependence will be reported, not assumed absent.
partition.source_record_id: colour:r, where r is the1-based data-row index within the colour file excluding header

preacquisition_amendment.reason: Root requested compact three-state representation and both k=2 andk=3 for each block before raw acquisition. No raw values have been acquired or inspected.

strict_order_only_definition: Same selected set but changed order AND no equal selected scores under either coding. Additional pairwise strict reversals may be recorded separately. Exact rational comparisons only.
